The '''Ewok Festival of Love Crossbow''' was a unique weapon, offered to [[Spacer/Legends|spacers]] during the [[Festival of Love]] in exchange for [[Chak heart]]s. If used on an enemy, the arrows would cause the enemy's hate of you to lessen.

==Behind the scenes==
This "weapon" could be purchased by players in ''[[Star Wars Galaxies]]'' during the Ewok Festival of Love.
